signal: Gnosis Freight named to G2's 2026 Best Software Awards and the FreightTech 100, backed by Vista Equity Partners

email.body1:
Nick, saw Gnosis landed on G2's 2026 Best Software list and the FreightTech 100, with Vista backing.

Recognition and momentum like that open more logistics accounts than the team can personally cover before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Gnosis off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nick, quick follow-up for Gnosis.

Growth momentum usually expands the in-market list faster than headcount can keep up, and the coverage gap shows up late as a missed quarter. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Gnosis needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nick, last bit of proof for Gnosis.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Gnosis' reply rate likely compares to other logistics-tech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nick, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Riding a growth surge is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a logistics-tech motion? I'll tailor it to Gnosis either way.
